clauses.title: CL-D106 records when a record is written
clauses.section: ## CL-D106 — A record is written only for a decision that changes an obligation
requires: A contract record is written for a decision that changes what a gate, the writer, or the driver must or must not do.
A choice that only sets a figure, a path or a wording
as a forward note in that record ("CL-Dnn later …") that cites the owner decision permitting it
Writing a record for a figure, path or wording choice alone, or recording an obligation change only in an issue thread, requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: CONTRACT.md names when a record is written
requires: A record is written only for a decision that changes an obligation; a figure, path or wording choice is a forward note in the record that holds it (CL-D106).
